entries.title: See updated Jobs after correcting readings
entries.description: Amending a Reading Exception or re-verifying its photo now refreshes affected Jobs automatically.

entries.title: Resolve Job errors in the dialog
entries.description: When a Job change is refused, the reason appears once in the dialog where you made the change. Reopening the dialog clears the previous error.

entries.title: Keep driver and implement selections during arrival capture
entries.description: Your selections are now compared with the assignment you opened, so a background refresh cannot cause intended changes to be missed.

entries.title: Keep manually edited prices as calculations change
entries.description: Manually edited machine and diesel amounts remain fixed even when the calculated amount catches up with them. Calculated amounts continue to update until the Job is marked as Priced.

entries.title: See why a Measure Type cannot be deleted
entries.description: Deletion messages now distinguish between a Measure Type used by a Rate and one recorded on Jobs.

entries.title: Keep Field Notes offline
entries.description: Save notes and photos on your phone without a connection, then search, edit and close them later. Photos taken in Notes also save to the Jedidiah album for use when capturing readings online.

entries.title: Capture readings from earlier photos
entries.description: Choose a meter photo from your gallery and set Read At to when the meter was read. The photo's capture time is suggested when available, and you can adjust it before saving.

entries.title: Return to the open Job after adding a machine
entries.description: Adding a machine now returns you to the Job already open. Arrival and departure capture also stays within the Job's navigation.
